help: squash-merge that PR pinned to its inspected head, then converge this checkout: base checked out, fetched, fast-forwarded — no message flags, so the body is assembled from the branch's commits and keeps their signatures

args.name: pr
args.help: the PR to merge: a number, a URL, or a branch

sends: gh pr view — reads the PR's head before the irreversible step
gh pr merge --squash — WRITES the merge (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
git fetch origin — reads the squash back so the base can fast-forward
